name: Status Meeting
description: Concise project or program status with variance, risks, decisions, and look-ahead.

sections.title: Executive Status
sections.instruction: Summarize current status, progress, and the most important change since the prior update.

sections.title: Milestones and Variances
sections.instruction: List milestones, dates, progress, and schedule or scope variances.

sections.title: Issues, Risks, and Dependencies
sections.instruction: List active issues, risks, assumptions, dependencies, and escalations.

sections.title: Actions
sections.instruction: List actions with owners and due dates when stated.

sections.title: Look-ahead and Parking Lot
sections.instruction: List upcoming work and deferred topics.
